spec_match.rationale: Calls LanguageDetector.availability() with and without expectedInputLanguages, per spec IDL; supported list copied from Chromium kSupportedLanguages; RangeError for invalid tags observed live.

interactive.rationale: Two check buttons, navigator.languages fill, and a per-language sweep table; all real calls.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Lede promises the raw value with and without expectedInputLanguages; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Invalid tag (RangeError), unsupported tag (unavailable), not-exposed and timeout paths all surfaced.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5087964794322944, the spec section, and the v161 Translator-on-Android sibling.

conformance.rationale: Inherits the immutable feature-level suite (5 pass, 1 fail here). The failing assertion is translation-can-detect-capability-query: the legacy translation.canDetect() namespace is not exposed in current Chrome, so no demo change can make it pass. Flagged for a human; the suite was not edited.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright Chromium 157.0.8103.78 headless (Linux) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; every visible control clicked; 0 console errors, 0 failed requests, 0px horizontal overflow, no control under 44px tall. LanguageDetector is exposed but availability() returns 'unavailable' in this sandbox, so only the unavailable/fallback paths ran. chrome-devtools-mcp is NOT available in this environment: verification is headless Playwright + screenshots, not DevTools MCP.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert on the primary check (known token or labelled throw) and on the sweep.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables for text/background; AA pairs (black/ivory, charcoal/stone, emerald-dark and rose as bold text on light backgrounds); button overrides set both background and color.

accessibility.rationale: Native labelled controls, polite live regions and visible focus. The accessibility tree was not inspected with chrome-devtools-mcp (unavailable here).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800; controls wrap; 44px targets; screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Capture the success path on a real Android phone (Chrome 157+)
openQuestions.detail: In this container availability() is 'unavailable', so create()/detect() never succeeded. Run on Chrome for Android with the model present and record available/downloadable values, real detect() arrays, and download progress.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Labels, roles and live regions were checked in the DOM only; chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable here (rule 7b).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow on narrow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: 44x44 touch targets on touch screens; components wrap to their container; nothing clipped at narrow widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls use flex-wrap and auto-fit minmax(min(100%,Nrem),1fr) grids; buttons/inputs/selects min-height 44px; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status for async results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native labelled controls and announce async outcomes as text in a polite live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every readout is role=status aria-live=polite with the complete outcome in one update; inputs have <label for>; focus-visible outline uses --accent-blue.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive table readable on small screens
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with caption, wrapped in a focusable role=region scroller with an accessible name.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Tables have <caption> and th scope, inside .table-scroll with tabindex=0, role=region and aria-labelledby the caption.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Guide is gated as a volatile feature (needs `npx modern-web-guidance@latest set-allow-volatile-features`). The gate was not bypassed.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception: the task explicitly names the Language Detector API. Code is grounded in the spec IDL and Chromium language_detector.cc/.idl instead and is unverified against the gated guide; a human can unlock it with `npx modern-web-guidance@latest set-allow-volatile-features` and re-review.

summary: Basic availability concept for the Android listing: raw availability() values with and without expectedInputLanguages, per-language sweep, Chromium's supported list.
